comparison.objective: Rearrange household items by use frequency for accessible storage; candidate commissions robot-axis damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object pick-and-place and shelf planning versus fine tool manipulation and feedback-driven mechanism adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Specified items rest on assigned shelves within 8 mm and 15° versus impact-energy, stroke, rebound, overload, and lock-retention criteria.
comparison.reason: Accessibility-oriented placement does not test mechanical commissioning.
